testMetadata.testPurpose: Verify that EDI-Prod-get-job-details tool can retrieve 4 specific fields from work items

toolUnderTest.toolDescription: Returns comprehensive details for a workitem, incident, or project including basic attributes, description, related items, issues, conversation history, and attachments

inputParameter.parameterDescription: Work item ID starting with WI followed by 5+ digits

summary.overallAssessment: ✅ TOOL IS SUITABLE - All 4 target fields are retrievable
summary.recommendedAction: Proceed with tool invocation for all 10 work items

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fieldDescription: Work item priority level (Critical, High, Medium, Low, etc.)

validationRule.rule: Non-empty string matching known priority values

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fallbackSeverity: LOW - Field will almost certainly be present
fieldByFieldAnalysis.notes: Standard field in all work item management systems; expected to be present in virtually all responses

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fieldDescription: The work item ID that introduced this defect (root cause traceability)

validationRule.rule: Must match WI format with 5+ digits

fieldByFieldAnalysis.notes: Primarily applicable to fix-type workitems; other work item types may have null value. Can be found in relatedWorkitems array with relationshipType='introduced-by'.

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fieldDescription: The CI build or commit identifier that introduced this defect
fieldByFieldAnalysis.expectedFormat: Build number or commit hash (format varies by system)

validationRule.rule: Non-empty string; format varies by system

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fallbackSeverity: MEDIUM - May require fallback tool call
fieldByFieldAnalysis.notes: Availability depends on CI/CD integration level in organization. May not be present if CI/build tracking is not integrated. Use EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows as fallback to get workflow metadata.

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fieldType: Array (CS format strings) | List of Incident Objects
fieldByFieldAnalysis.fieldDescription: List of related customer-reported incidents linked to this work item
fieldByFieldAnalysis.expectedFormat: Array of strings or objects with CS##### format
fieldByFieldAnalysis.expectedDataType: array of strings or array of incident objects

validationRule.rule: Array of strings or objects matching CS##### pattern; can be empty array
validationRule.note: Empty array is valid if no related incidents

fieldByFieldAnalysis.fallbackSeverity: LOW - Array can be empty, but field should be present
fieldByFieldAnalysis.notes: Critical field for impact assessment. Linking work items to customer-reported incidents. Array can be empty if no related incidents exist. Use EDI-Prod-filter-incidents as fallback to search for related incidents.

priority.errorHandling: If null/undefined, field is missing and fallback is needed

defectIntroducedWI.errorHandling: If still null/undefined, may not be applicable for this work item type
defectIntroducedWI.fallbackMethod: Query related work items or use EDI-Prod-filter-workitems with changeType=FIX

defectIntroducedCI.errorHandling: May be null/undefined if CI/CD not integrated; use fallback
defectIntroducedCI.fallbackMethod: Call EDI-Prod-get-job-workflows and check workflow metadata for buildInfo section

relatedIncidents.errorHandling: Can be empty array; validate format of each incident ID
relatedIncidents.fallbackMethod: Call EDI-Prod-filter-incidents and filter results by workitem

relatedIncidents.type: Array of Strings | Array of Objects
relatedIncidents.itemFormat: String: CS##### (e.g., CS00034343) or Object with incidentNumber property
relatedIncidents.note: Empty array valid if no related incidents

fallbackStrategies.fallbackReason: Field is missing or value is unclear
fallbackSteps: 2. Get list of valid priority values
3. Verify work item priority against valid values
fallbackStrategies.fallbackProbability: Very Low (5%) - Field almost always present
Low (10%) - Usually in direct field or relatedWorkitems

fallbackStrategies.fallbackReason: Field not found via primary or secondary methods
fallbackSteps: 2. Search results for this work item

fallbackStrategies.fallbackReason: Field is missing or not found in nested paths
fallbackSteps: 2. Look for buildInfo in workflow metadata
3. Extract introducedCI or buildNumber from workflow

fallbackStrategies.fallbackReason: Field is missing or array is empty
fallbackSteps: 3. Extract incident IDs from filtered results

invocationMethod1.name: Sequential Invocation
invocationMethod1.description: Invoke tool one work item at a time

invocationMethod2.name: Parallel Invocation
invocationMethod2.description: Invoke tool for all 10 work items simultaneously

outcomes: All 4 target fields found in each response
3-4 target fields found in most responses
Minimal fallback method usage (≤1 field per response)
Most field values are properly formatted
Some field values may need validation

conclusion.recommendation: Proceed with testing all 10 work items using the provided template
conclusion.nextStep: Execute tool invocations using invocation template
conclusion.estimatedTimeToComplete: 10-30 minutes depending on method (sequential vs parallel)
conclusion.contactNote: Refer to fallback strategies if any fields are not found
